svg.text: Hands on the table: what each gesture does
Touch the table and lift again, within a second.
Presses the button there, or plays on the map there.
Keep a finger still for 0.6 seconds. No need to lift.
A ring fills, then it clicks: the same as a tap.
Stand a piece on your own half of the map.
It plays there once. Lift it and put it back to play again.
Anything wider than a few fingers is ignored,
so leaning on the table presses nothing.
Tap +, − or Whole map at the top of your panel.
The map is not dragged by hand in the game.
Slide one hand across the table.
The map zooms in, around the point between them.
Move two hands towards each other.
Put an object on a street
Anything that stands still for a second closes the street
under it. Traffic finds another way. Lift it to reopen.
